Document custom/restricted-capability removal as manifest checklist item 6 in MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md and add a carve-out to item 3's 'keep capabilities you use' rule, since a sideloaded WinUI 3 package cannot honor SCCD-gated capabilities.
Extend SKILL.md manifest pre-flight (item 5) to call out 'no SCCD-gated uap4:CustomCapability' alongside the existing background-task pitfall.
